asr.full_text: hello and welcome to another update video on the avex chart yeah avex avalanche um what we see here is the coinbase chart and the price has been in a correction for quite some time now unfortunately we haven't really seen any decent upside reversal recently and the market continues to be in this very, very extended correction which actually started in March 2024. Now we're at a point where really the bulls need to show up, guys. To keep any sort of bullish scenario alive, really. What we have seen is obviously a five wave decline from the all time high in 2021. So that is already not a great start because any five wave decline from an all time high is a critical indicator that the bulls are losing, right? That the bulls are not in control and this also has long term implications i mean if we if we're tracking a chart and the long term trend is down or five waves down um yeah why you know why why invest in it i mean that's just not really a point to buy you know um of course this is only one perspective there is also a bullish scenario and it's not so much about predicting something right it is more about understanding the dynamics of reward and risk now what you see here on this chart in the white scenario and the yellow scenario there is a bullish case. And at the moment, we are deep in support, very, very deep in support, very deep in support actually for a B wave pullback or a wave two pullback. So you see that after the lows in October 23 and December 22, it's possible to consider a rally from there. and and December 22 we have it's possible to consider a rally from there. I mean, the question is do we.. I might move that yellow count here.. we do have five waves down and and we have even.. you could consider it guys five waves up but what did we have then? we get a very, very complex looking correction so again 5 waves down.. five waves up five waves down because it is five down but the five wave move to the downside is slow it's overlapping you know and so from that point of view it's entirely possible this is just a simple, not a simple a very complex, correction. A very, very complex correction. W, X, Y, X, Z structures are 5 wave moves. 5 wave movements so it could be something bearish. We need to consider that. And to be honest there are various ways to how a bearish scenario could be counted here or interpreted absolutely um i think it's just important to understand that it is possible to interpret it as a corrective pullback especially considering the extent yeah the extent of that correction i mean we've been correcting for many many many, many, many months now, more than a year, and whenever we do that, you know, and we've seen a correction, let's measure that, extend 85%, like 80 to 85%. And so if we have 80 to 85% correction and the correction lasted for more than a year, that's normally bear market quality. So, what if AVAX actually formed a low here or is trying to form a low, at least, and might turn around and complete a bear market here. I mean, it's entirely possible, it's just one scenario, right? But, as I said, it's not so much about predicting because at the moment, the trend is still down. It's about understanding the dynamics of reward and risk, and at the moment, I think, it's not so much about predicting because at the moment, the trend is still down. It's about understanding the dynamics of reward and risk and at the moment, I think the reward to risk ratio is more favorable for the bulls, right? For long positions. That doesn't mean it's the right time to buy. That really whether it's the right time to buy or not, always depends on your own trading strategy. Yeah. Portfolio, skill level and everything, of course. But I think obviously now it wouldn't be the right time to short from here, usually not, if there is room for a rally. But it can make sense to observe the structure, absolutely possible to observe the structure and wait for a micro 5 wave move up because a 5 wave move up would be an indication that we've bottomed and potentially that we've bottomed from actually a significant low. So this is key. We are at the 78.6 retracement at $12.53, We are at the lower boundary line, and I think this is the area from where a bounce could occur. It's obviously too early to confirm, and we don't have a five-wave move-up yet, but this is the support zone where I would be watching for a low, this area. I wouldn't really call that a decisive break below the $12.50 level, the 78.6 retracement either so once i see a five wave move up on the micro level i will of course let you know if we see a local 1-2 setup to the upside that would be an indication that indeed we might have bottomed at the moment we are in a larger decline but this chart is so extended to the downside, has reached key support levels, especially also here structural support that a bounce would be likely. In the yellow count, it could be a C wave up that can take us above $100. In the white count, it could even take us higher. At the moment, I don't see that as the most probable scenario. But yellow is realistic. For now, the trend is down is down though so blue is still leading. But this is exactly the transition point where yellow could take the lead. But we haven't broken any critical resistance and we don't really have any upside momentum. So obviously we're watching for reaction here. Just a little bit too early to confirm a reversal. But it's something to watch. It's just something to be aware of certainly not a high quality setup yet because for for that we would need a local five wave move up followed by a three wave pullback but of course I'll keep you informed. I hope you liked the update if you did please hit the like button leave a comment and subscribe and if you really like the content then please check out the channel membership.
